scope: offline batch diagnosis only; no live session or recording
fixture_rule: prepend exact-zero PCM16 mono 16000Hz silence; decoded source samples after the prefix must remain byte-identical
batch_rule: submit sequentially to deployed port-7860 batch API only while idle; production model/runtime unchanged; preserve submit, terminal, and segments JSON
prediction: tokens and/or parsed segments decrease or a job early-stops/fails as leading silence grows; the 210-second case reproduces the S01 class
reproduction_verdict_rule: CONFIRMED when the 210-second case has fewer parsed segments than the 17-segment control or terminates without a parseable transcript; report the complete dose response without requiring strict monotonicity

prospective_fix.eligibility: only a detected silence_start at <=0.05 seconds is leading silence
prospective_fix.trim: first corresponding silence_end minus 0.250 seconds preroll, floored at zero and rounded to an integer source sample
prospective_fix.timestamp_mapping: add sample_offset/sample_rate to every returned start/end; provenance records sample_offset, sample_rate, and seconds
prospective_fix.regression: the 210-second fixture must yield the same token and segment counts as the accepted control after automatic trim, with returned timestamps shifted back into original tape time
